notes: All people, race venues and results are fictional. Emails use non-deliverable example.invalid addresses.
Exactly 20 reusable riders, 3 races, 2 organisers and 60 race-specific rider entries.

Completed race tests rankings, handicap reordering, tied actual results, DNS and DNF. Live race tests racing, waiting, DNS, three unassigned finishes and one pending upload. Setup race tests start order and imports.
Two lap crossings then a separate finish is a test assumption, not a confirmed course rule.
Expected results are an independent comparison view, not the source of truth.
This JSON is an application seed fixture, not a CSV entry-upload file; a seed loader must map these records to the eventual backend.
No real email, RiderHQ connection, publication or credentials are included. Two organisers do not imply two devices: three station sessions per race are simulated.
Timestamps use explicit +01:00 and Europe/London for these October dates. All durations use integer milliseconds.
